people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
translations.bsb: The descendants of Gershon received thirteen cities by lot from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
translations.kjv: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
translations.asv: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
